title: Superscript (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Superscript applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Superscript (BtnFormatSuperscript) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Superscript applies to selected text on the real host
scenarios.expected: Applying Superscript to the selected probe text sets the superscript attribute exactly (mutually exclusive with subscript), leaves the text and geometry unchanged and produces one PowerPoint Undo entry.
